name: Quill Rat pack (Quill Rat Druid mod)
notes: qr_quill_bear: the Spike Fiend's own mesh, reshaped (back quills 1.55x longer and 1.7x thicker, torso heavier), plus a bone tusk on every fourth back quill joint. Quill joints are spike_01..62_jnt; back joints 20-62 point their quill along local -X and the tusk prop is long along +Z, so y -90 stands it up. Seen in the game on 2026-11-13: body and tusks are drawn and animate. The new model path is listed in hd/model_lod_desc.bin, which the pipeline writes; without it the body is invisible. 2026-11-13: the tusk props on the bear were removed at the user's request (the "attach" list is gone; the qr_bone_spine prop is still defined above if it is wanted again).
